source_title: Artificial intelligence: Council gives final green light to simplify and streamline rules
summary: The Council of the EU gave its final approval to the Digital Omnibus on AI on 29 June 2026, completing the co-legislators' formal adoption after the European Parliament's 16 June plenary vote. This locks in the deferral of Annex III standalone high-risk obligations from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027, and Annex I product-embedded high-risk obligations to 2 August 2028, together with the new prohibitions and the Article 50(2) transition to 2 December 2026. The only remaining step is publication in the Official Journal of the European Union; the act enters into force on the third day after publication.
mechanical_change: The amendment is now adopted by both co-legislators but is not yet in force: it takes legal effect three days after Official Journal publication, which is pending (expected before 2 August 2026). Until publication, the original 2 August 2026 deadline for Annex III high-risk obligations technically remains binding, though the deferral is now settled in substance.
